title: Subtract stock before rounding
hook: Boxes hold six. Does twelve required mean ordering two boxes?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Apply package rounding to the shortage rather than total demand.

misconception: Package rounding should be applied before existing stock is subtracted.
objective: Apply package rounding to the shortage rather than total demand.

claims.text: Three usable units are in stock. New orders come only in six-unit boxes. Scaled model; stock=3; indivisible six-unit boxes.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Required=12, A=12items and B=9items. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",6,["ceil",["/",["max",0,["-","x",3]],6]]]; B=["max",0,["-","x",3]]; x denotes Required. At x=12, A=12, B=9; recall at x=15: B=12. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: Compute the shortage first, then round that shortage to whole boxes. Rounding the total requirement before subtracting stock uses the wrong input. Extra units after delivery remain visible in the count.

claims.text: Three usable units are in stock. New orders come only in six-unit boxes. Change only Required to 15. What is B (Exact-gap) now? Correct: 12items. Use B's stated rule with Required=15: it gives 12items. Compute the shortage first, then round that shortage to whole boxes. Rounding the total requirement before subtracting stock uses the wrong input. Extra units after delivery remain visible in the count.

recall.question: Three usable units are in stock. New orders come only in six-unit boxes. Change only Required to 15. What is B (Exact-gap) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Required=15: it gives 12items. Compute the shortage first, then round that shortage to whole boxes. Rounding the total requirement before subtracting stock uses the wrong input. Extra units after delivery remain visible in the count.
